dedupe_keys.name: togo national road inventory on opendata gouv tg road network 799 classified road segments rural tracks 5 054 drainage channels traffic lights and road furniture csv with wkt geometry

description: The Togo national open data portal opendata.gouv.tg publishes a set of road inventory layers from the government's Geodata Togo field census, attributed to the Ministry of Transport. Contents: the road network (a 139 MB file with number of lanes, road type, classified status, surface and road name for each segment), 799 classified road segments, the combined roads, rural tracks and classified status layer (111 MB), 5,054 roadside drainage channels with depth, 546 traffic lights, crossroads, pedestrian crossings, speed bumps, sidewalks, road signs, parking areas, bus stations and weighbridge or toll stations. Producer: the Togolese government through Geodata Togo, with collection dates per feature. Coverage: all five regions (Maritime, Plateaux, Centrale, Kara, Savanes) down to canton level. Format and access: CSV files with WKT geometry (lines and points in WGS84) that download without registration; each dataset also has a small schema file. Licence: listed as other open licence on the portal. Caveats: bridges, culverts and other hydraulic structures, natural and man-made obstacles and pavement damage layers are private and only their column schemas are public, with the full data on request; the files were loaded in December 2024 and January 2025 and are flagged as irregularly updated. Simulation uses: building a routable national road graph with surface and class attributes for accessibility and network flow studies, flood exposure of roads and drainage, and emergency access planning. Related records: the Togo drinking water points record (data-togo-geodata-drinking-water-points-water-towers-standpipes-hand-pumps) comes from the same census.
